```{r}
#| echo: false

here::i_am("Data-management-project-Saihou-kate.Rproj")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Import datasets
credit <- read.csv(
  "Total credit to the non-financial sector.csv",
  skip = 3
)
credit_HH<-read.csv("Total credit to households.csv",
                    skip= 3)

gdp <- read.csv(
  "GDP (constant_ 2015 _US$).csv",
  skip = 4
)

CPI <- read.csv(
  "Consumer price index (2010 = 100).csv",
  skip = 4
)

GDP_Growth <- read.csv(
  "GDP growth (annual %).csv",
  skip = 4
)

Trade_Openness <- read.csv(
  "Trade-Percentage-GDP.csv",
  skip = 4
)

Unemployment_rate <- read.csv(
  "Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate).csv",
  skip = 4
)
```

## Initial dataset inspection
```{r}
# storing unedited datasets in list
datasets <- list(
  "Total credit to non-financial sector" = credit,
  "Total credit to households" = credit_HH,
  "GDP" = gdp,
  "Consumer Price Index" = CPI,
  "GDP Growth" = GDP_Growth,
  "Trade Openness" = Trade_Openness,
  "Unemployment Rate" = Unemployment_rate
)

# description for each dataset
for (name in names(datasets)) {
  data <- datasets[[name]]
  cat("\n\n##", name, "\n")

  # dimensions
  cat("Rows:", nrow(data), "\n")
  cat("Columns:", ncol(data), "\n\n")

  # variable types
  cat("Variable types:\n")
  cat("Numeric:", sum(sapply(data, is.numeric)), "\n")
  cat("Character:", sum(sapply(data, is.character)), "\n")
  cat("Integer:", sum(sapply(data, is.integer)), "\n")

  # missing values
  cat("\nTotal missing values:", sum(is.na(data)), "\n")
}
```


## Transform GDP data

```{r}
#| echo: false

gdp_long <- gdp |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "GDP"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(sub("^X", "", Year)))
```

## Transform CPI data

```{r}
CPI_long <- CPI |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "CPI"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(sub("^X", "", Year)))
```

## Transform GDP_growth data

```{r}
gdp_Growth_long <- GDP_Growth |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "GDP_Growth"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(sub("^X", "", Year)))
```

## Transform Trade Openness data

```{r}
Trade_Openness_long <- gdp |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Trade_Openness"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(sub("^X", "", Year)))
```

## Transform credit data

```{r}
credit_long <- credit |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "debt_GDP_ratio"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = sub("^X", "", Year))
```

## Transform credit_HH data

```{r}
credit_HH_long <- credit_HH |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "debt_GDP_ratio_HH"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = sub("^X", "", Year))
```

## Transform Umemployment data
```{r}
Unemployment_long <- Unemployment_rate |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Umemployment_rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = sub("^X", "", Year))
```

## selecting last-quarter entries for (household) credit data from BIS dataset
```{r}
library(lubridate)

credit_annual <- credit_long %>% 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Year, format = "%Y.%m.%d")) %>% 
  filter(quarter(Date) == 4) %>% 
           mutate(Year = year(Date)) %>% 
  select(-Date)

credit_HH_annual <- credit_HH_long %>% 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Year, format = "%Y.%m.%d")) %>% 
  filter(quarter(Date) == 4) %>% 
           mutate(Year = year(Date)) %>% 
  select(-Date)

```


## Rename country column
```{r}
credit_annual<-credit_annual |> 
  rename(Country.Name= Borrowers..country)

credit_HH_annual<-credit_HH_annual |> 
  rename(Country.Name= Borrowers..country)
```


## convert Years into integers
```{r}
gdp_long <- gdp_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

gdp_Growth_long <- gdp_Growth_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

Trade_Openness_long <- Trade_Openness_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

Unemployment_long <- Unemployment_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

CPI_long <- CPI_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))
```



## Merge GDP and credit data

```{r}
Merged_data <- credit_annual |>
  inner_join(
    gdp_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, GDP),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(credit_HH_annual |> select(Country.Name, Year, debt_GDP_ratio_HH),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    gdp_Growth_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, GDP_Growth),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    Trade_Openness_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, Trade_Openness),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    Unemployment_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, Umemployment_rate),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    CPI_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, CPI),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  )
```

##  merged dataset Inspection

```{r}
nrow(Merged_data)
str(Merged_data)
summary(Merged_data)
colSums(is.na(Merged_data))
sum(is.na(gdp_long$GDP))

n_distinct(Merged_data$Country.Name)
```


### test correlation 

```{r}
Merged_data |>
  filter(Year == 2011) |>
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(GDP_Growth,
      debt_GDP_ratio,
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  )

Merged_data |>
  filter(Year == 2011) |>
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(GDP_Growth,
      debt_GDP_ratio_HH,
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  )

```


```{r}
Cor_table<-Merged_data |> 
  filter(Year %in% 2000:2015) |>
  group_by(Year) |> 
  summarise(correlation = cor(GDP_Growth,debt_GDP_ratio, use = "complete.obs"))

Cor_table

```

## household debt correlation to gdp growth
```{r}
Cor_table<-Merged_data |> 
  filter(Year %in% 2000:2015) |>
  group_by(Year) |> 
  summarise(correlation_HH = cor(GDP_Growth,debt_GDP_ratio_HH, use = "complete.obs"),
            correlation_non_private_sec = cor(GDP_Growth,debt_GDP_ratio, use = "complete.obs"))

Cor_table

```



### Correlation graph
```{r}
Merged_data |> 
  filter(Year == 2011) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=GDP_Growth, y = debt_GDP_ratio))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

Merged_data |> 
  filter(Year == 2009) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=GDP_Growth, y = debt_GDP_ratio_HH))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

```


##  Evolution of household debt from 2000 to 2015
```{r}
Merged_data |> 
  filter(Year %in% 2000:2015, Country.Name %in% c("France","Germany","United States", "Spain")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Year,y= debt_GDP_ratio_HH, colour = Country.Name))+
  geom_line()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000,2015, by=2))
```
